hero.description: Tests, mock exams, and AI supported by context we review every day from Spain's Official State Gazette. One platform that grows with you, one exam path at a time.

manifesto.titleLead: The syllabus changes. Your method should not fall
manifesto.description: We bring study, practice, and regulatory context together so every session has a clear purpose, without scattering your attention across different tools.
manifesto.note: Each exam path is added when its content is ready. No empty catalogs or premature promises.

story.eyebrow: From the BOE to your study session
story.title: Official content becomes useful practice.
story.description: A workflow designed to preserve context, reveal what needs reinforcement, and help you study consistently.

review.title: We read the change.
review.description: We review updates from Spain's Official State Gazette every day and refresh the relevant preparation context.

context.title: The AI understands where it comes from.
context.description: Reviewed regulations feed the AI context so it can answer within the study framework of each exam path.

practice.title: You turn it into practical study questions.
practice.description: Work through topic tests and mock exams, review mistakes, and return to the concepts that need attention.

progress.title: Every session prepares the next.
progress.description: Set your pace, stay focused, and use your activity to decide the next study step.

context.question: Which part of this change affects my syllabus?
context.answer: The AI relates the question to the reviewed regulatory context and the topic you are studying.

practice.question: Choose an answer and review the reasoning.
practice.optionA: Apply the concept without checking the scenario
practice.optionB: Connect the rule, scenario, and answer
practice.explanation: The explanation connects the result to the content you should reinforce.

oppositions.titleAccent: A dedicated path for every exam.
oppositions.description: The system follows one study logic while every path keeps its own syllabus, tests, and regulatory context.
oppositions.catalogNote: The catalog is released progressively. Inside the app, you can check which paths are available at any time.

treasury.name: Tax and Treasury

justice.name: Justice
justice.description: Preparation for roles within Spain's Justice Administration.

administration.name: Public Administration
administration.description: Paths for administrative and management roles across public bodies.

health.name: Healthcare
health.description: Paths for competitive selection processes in healthcare and statutory services.

education.name: Education
education.description: Preparation for teaching selection processes, organized by role and specialty.

experience.description: Everything you need to ask, practice, and move forward lives in the same study flow.

ai.label: 01 · Context
ai.title: Ask from a relevant foundation
ai.description: Work through questions with AI that uses reviewed regulatory context to support your preparation.

tests.label: 02 · Practice
tests.title: Train with topic tests and mock exams
tests.description: Alternate short sessions with fuller tests and turn every mistake into a clue for what to review.

focus.label: 03 · Rhythm
focus.title: Keep your focus visible
focus.description: Organize your sessions, check your activity, and resume studying with a clear next step.

visual.question: Explain this change within my current study topic.
visual.response: The response connects the question to the content and points to what is worth reviewing.

daily.description: We review the BOE every day and update the context used by the AI so your preparation starts from a carefully maintained foundation.
daily.note: The daily review provides study context; always check the official source when you need to confirm a provision.

final.description: Choose an available path that fits your goal and begin building a sustainable study rhythm.
final.note: Explore the platform and check the availability of each exam path.

footer.description: Multi-exam preparation with context-aware AI, tests, and regulatory content reviewed every day.
footer.newsletterDescription: Get catalog news and practical study advice

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: They help us measure usage and improve content and performance.

marketing.title: Marketing
